## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (including a case where a rule should *not* fire)
- [ ] `dotnet test tests\Analyxell.Core.Tests` passes
- [ ] `scripts\check-secrets.ps1` passes
- [ ] `tests\ui\smoke.ps1` passes (if the app UI changed)
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] ADR or BDR added if this is a technical or product decision
- [ ] No real captures, secrets, paths or personal data in code, tests or screenshots
- [ ] The change keeps the app read-only, or explains the explicit user action it adds
